relations.label: 'dul TIka 'thad ldan (4682) has as an instance ti ka 'thad ldan (8098)

comments:
Pp. 229-378 in vol. 1 of [BKB649FN]. Only fols. 150 to 225 are available (75 folios, due to a numbering mistake: no. 212 is skipped).

Contains 
i) the end of the section "spyir bstan rnam par 'byed pa'i ti ka 'thad ldan," which has its own colophon, on fols. 150-182,
ii) on fols. 182-225b, the beginning of the section  starting with "bslab pa de phun sum ‘tshogs pa nyid du bsgrub par byed pa lhag ma bzhi’ bcu’ drug gis brjod pa la," which has its own cover page with the title "bzhi bcu drug gi dam bsal bar bston pa'i ti ka 'thad ldan" (fol. 183a). The end of the text up to the final colophon is missing (corresponding to 5 folios in instance (ID:4681) and 4 folios in (ID:4683).

Another set of folio numbering in red ink numbers the folios of i) 43 to 75, and the folios of ii) 1 to 42.

The numbering error of the first set for ii) - which skips no. 212 before 213 - is not echoed in the second set in red ink.
name: ti ka 'thad ldan
